title: The Twelve Greatnesses Reaching to Adam and Returning Home
description: The complete cosmology of redemption as a five-fold descent of Divine Greatness — from the hidden Father, through Mother of Life and First Man, through Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, and Jesus the Radiance — reaching down to the molding of Adam and Eve's flesh and returning home in the final gathering of all scattered light. The twelve "ascendings" are completed by Call and Answer (Father and Mother), and the Counsel of Life is planted in the elements as a hot stone in milk, ripening the dispersed light from within.
